issues.reading: Three arrows: upper bowed, straight middle, lower bowed

issues.location: Upper central map, live I after canceled N

issues.location: Upper image clause, word or sign after image

A sloping left stem and heavier right stem have a substantial white interval between them above the common bottom rule. This occurrence is visibly doubled.

issues.location: Detached pen traces between upper diagrams and prose

issues.location: Sideways margin, glyph above final J

notes: Observation: landscape full image is 2375 by 1690 pixels. Half a is 1247 by 1690; half b is 1248 by 1690. The whole and each supplied half were viewed once, followed by 13 distinct tight crops once each, in batches of at most two. No OCR, recognition, web, render or compilation was used.

Observation: an English typewriter strip is readable sideways along the left of a reused sheet. The rest consists of handwritten exploratory maps, order comparisons, cancellations and diagrams. Faint background traces do not yield additional recoverable words; no word count was invented for them.

Observation: the handwritten page discusses a family of ordered sets, increasing maps with image I_<=n, a named fiber at n prime, and a bottom expression involving classes of hom.topie of loops. These are content observations, not checked mathematical results.

Observation: no author title, date or manuscript folio is visible. The lower-left archive digit is 5. The H page header 5 corresponds to our scan 6. Its editorial section heading was not treated as manuscript text.

H_drawing.tex was authorized and its explicit header was verified: archive page 5, PDF page 6. Its actual path and filled vertex were compared with the visible bottom loop. The description was not counted as a second discrepancy.

Every C inline or contextual doubt for scan 6 is resolved or retained in the issues. Repeated eta/y and xi/f/x doubts are consolidated at the first live occurrence; this does not turn the later uncertain glyphs into resolved readings. The k/kappa/K alternative likewise remains at first occurrence.

The C_context stray row explicitly labelled scan 7 was already present when read. The parent notified its removal; it was excluded. All cross-page assertions in the scan-6 context were treated only as witness assertions, not independent evidence. No other page or reader file was opened.

Author uncertainty: no explicit question or author question mark can be securely identified. The two unfinished equalities, =(1+2)^n= and u_xi u_eta=, are retained with their blank right-hand continuations. Crossed drafting is described as cancellation, not as an explicit author doubt.

Own corrections and limitations: the larger B has partial doubled returns, so a mathbb alternative was added without imposing it. The high fleck and comma after ordonnés remain ambiguous in attachment. The old subscript in the upper image clause, several margin labels, and the crossed D-form before B remain uncertain after their one crops.

The supplied C drawing geometry was retained wherever it preserved the observed elements. Changes add small omitted traces, move the common D_n between the membership levels, correct the two turned memberships, and add the left peg to the lower oblique segment. TikZ remains an approximation, not a pixel facsimile.

The scan-7 row initially in C_context was an avoidable packet contamination and was excluded on notification. The one-pass rule left genuine doubts at the crossed margin forms and punctuation attachment; those are retained rather than re-cropped. No additional instruction was needed.
